caption: The drawing depicts an object consisting of a triangular metal frame with three ornate legs and an elaborate, decorative railing along two sides and the back, featuring a pattern of swirling scrolls. At the open front of the frame, there is a large, rounded dark brown handle attached to the base, which appears to be made of wood. The main body of the object is rusty brown in color, with the metal surfaces showing texture and patina, while the handle has a smooth, turned appearance with circular grooves. Inside the triangular frame, there are two jagged, toothed metal pieces, positioned parallel to each other and extending from the base inward. The entire object is set against a plain, light beige background, bringing attention to its detailed structure and craftsmanship.
title: Pa. German Flat-iron Stand
